questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.

questions.question: Your accelerator sticks open while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn.
Slam on your brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off your ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, turn off the ignition carefully. Move the ignition switch just enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply your brakes and move to a safe area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road narrows ahead.
There are curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of an upcoming winding road with curves.

questions.question: The traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and continue through.
Stop immediately.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a solid yellow light, slow down and stop before the intersection if it is safe. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers of unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow line to pass another car?

options.text: Yes.
No.
Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the car ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed from either direction. You can only cross these lines when turning into a driveway or business entrance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has curves.
Traffic increases ahead.
Steep grade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase the distance between your car and the car ahead.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass if you are in the lane with the broken line.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are smaller and harder to spot than cars. Even when drivers look, they may not see them. Stay alert to avoid hitting these smaller road users.

questions.question: You are backing out of your driveway and children are playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so they hear you.
Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of your car to check if the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, get out and look behind your car. Do not rely only on mirrors, especially around children. Always check that the way is clear before backing.

questions.question: When should you use hand-to-hand steering?

options.text: When turning the steering wheel during normal driving
When anti-lock brakes are engaged
When turning at low speeds
When backing up or when adjusting the radio, blinkers, or windshield wipers

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning the steering wheel during normal driving
questions.explanation: Use hand-to-hand steering when turning the steering wheel during normal driving. This is also called push-pull steering.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines mean you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What are crosswalks?

options.text: Always marked with lines on the pavement
Always marked with vertical lines on the pavement
Always unmarked
Either marked with lines or not marked at all

questions.correctAnswerText: Either marked with lines or not marked at all
questions.explanation: Crosswalks may have markings or no markings. You must stop behind the crosswalk to let pedestrians cross.

questions.question: What do round signs indicate?

options.text: No passing zones
School zones
Upcoming railroad crossings
Hospitals

questions.correctAnswerText: Upcoming railroad crossings
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers about upcoming railroad crossings. Use extra caution when you see these signs.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Appear at every location with danger
Tell you what you must or must not do
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green
Warn drivers about school zones

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell you what you must or must not do
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do, such as speed limits or turning rules.

questions.question: An approaching driver does not dim their high beams. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the other vehicle
Toward the right side of the road
Toward the left side of the road
Down the middle of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you see enough of the road to stay safe until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left
Turn your wheels to the right
Stop next to the car in front of your parking space
Back up slowly

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop next to the car in front of your parking space
questions.explanation: After checking traffic and signaling, stop next to the vehicle in front of the space you want. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: Passing is not allowed within ____ of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel.

options.text: 300 feet
200 feet
100 feet
500 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: Do not pass within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct, or tunnel. Only pass where other drivers can clearly see your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left
Turn right
Stop
Go straight

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight
In the direction you want the vehicle to go
In the opposite direction of the skid
In any direction

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Cause your engine to use too much oil.
Mean your vehicle needs a tune-up sooner than usual.
Make you feel sleepy while driving.
Start grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you feel sleepy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases, reduces noise, and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system are very dangerous and can cause drowsiness while you drive.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should merge into the lane shown by the arrow.
Should slow down and stop if it is safe to do so.
May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you may turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Always let vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection pass before you turn.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street with no emergency lights or siren on. You should:

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as possible.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive normally.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without lights or a siren, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.
Two-way left turn.
Traffic flows in both directions.
Minimum speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows in one direction only.
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. It shows the direction you must drive when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: U-turns are not allowed.
Two-way left turn.
Minimum speed limit.
No parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: U-turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. Wherever this sign is posted, you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What is the first thing to adjust when you get into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: First adjust your seat so you can reach the pedals comfortably and see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your seat position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead ends.
You must turn either right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead. The road splits, and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: At an intersection with no traffic signals or stop signs, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and go through.
Stop, look both ways, and then go.
Let all other drivers go first.
Be ready to yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield if needed.
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection, you must yield to vehicles coming from your right. Always be ready to yield by easing off the gas, covering the brake, and checking left, right, and left again.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending.
No right turn.
The road is slippery when wet.
Traffic flows in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black and alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you need to let traffic merge safely.
